reuse.result: Reuse PR338 hashes and reference-source verification below. No refreshed dependency replay, recalibration, fixed-output verification or CLI/Desktop execution was performed.

calibration.result: Each previous target pin reproduced exactly before its refreshed calculation; selected Bun outputs are unchanged between the two Nixpkgs revisions.
